name: OpenClaw
summary: Agent runtime and operating layer for SIndustries workflows.
whyWeUseIt: It gives agents memory, tools, messaging, and human-in-the-loop boundaries.

name: Plano
summary: Model routing infrastructure for local and hosted model workflows.
whyWeUseIt: It lets routine work use cheaper, faster routes while preserving stronger models for harder calls.

name: Local models
summary: Locally hosted model capacity for recurring automation work.
whyWeUseIt: Local routes can reduce cost, latency, and dependency on external capacity for suitable tasks.

name: Codex
summary: Coding agent surface for implementing and reviewing software changes.
whyWeUseIt: It can read the repo, make scoped changes, run checks, and produce PR-ready work.

name: MiniMax
summary: Model route used for selected agent and infrastructure workflows.
whyWeUseIt: It provides another practical model option for routine execution and resilience.

name: Telegram
summary: Messaging channel for agent interaction and operational updates.
whyWeUseIt: It keeps human review and task updates close to the channels already in use.

name: Tasks API
summary: Task source of truth for status, ownership, comments, and review handoffs.
whyWeUseIt: It gives agent work a shared operational backbone instead of scattered notes.

name: Vite
summary: Frontend build tooling for the SIndustries website.
whyWeUseIt: It keeps the website fast to develop, test, and deploy.

name: React
summary: UI framework for the SIndustries website and app surfaces.
whyWeUseIt: It supports component reuse and straightforward integration with structured content files.
